items.title: Existence of an element of the maximal ideal whose radical is the maximal ideal, matching an element of an integral extension inside the product of localizations
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a one-dimensional Noetherian local ring A with product of minimal-prime localizations L and an integral ring map K -> L, there are a in the maximal ideal and x in K with the same image in L and with the maximal ideal equal to the radical of (a). The proof reduces A via the power-works lemma to the reduced case, replaces K by its image so that K is reduced and Spec(K) is a finite discrete space, hence K is a finite product of fields (proof lines 7639-7645). It then lists the minimal primes of A, sets A_j to be the normalization of A/p_j (a semi-local Dedekind domain), and proceeds to construct the required element by summing the numbers of maximal ideals and choosing a and x accordingly (proof lines 7648 onwards). H2: the reduction to a finite product of fields and the subsequent construction through the normalizations are the substance; the author marks two auxiliary steps as 'some details omitted', which concern only the reduction and the closedness of Spec(L) -> Spec(K).
